# Head-to-Head — vs. Python Heuristics — Tables

Quality is minimum separation on U1, as on the [Python-heuristics comparison](tier2.md); `max-div` cells are the median over seeds at the quoted budget, entrant cells the mean over seeds with the mean measured time in parentheses.

## I. Summary per size

The overtake budget is the smallest budget of the series at which `max-div`'s median reaches the best one-shot result; a dash means it did not within 60 s.

--8<-- "docs/benchmarks/third_party/head_to_head/results/tier2_summary.md"

## II. Entrants per size

A dash marks a size outside the tool's scaling time limit.
